falcon-9.title: Falcon 9 and Crew Dragon at Cape Canaveral
falcon-9.context: Falcon 9 on the launch pad for NASA's Crew-9 mission in 2024. Representative rocket-family photograph, not the selected launch.
falcon-9.summary: SpaceX's two-stage orbital launcher uses a recoverable first stage on many missions. The selected mission's rocket configuration may differ.

vulcan.title: Vulcan rocket at Cape Canaveral
vulcan.context: ULA Vulcan launch infrastructure and vehicle during a 2021 countdown-rehearsal campaign. Representative rocket-family photograph.
vulcan.summary: ULA's Vulcan Centaur combines a main rocket stage with a high-energy Centaur upper stage. Configurations vary with mission requirements.

starship.title: Starship flight test photographed from the International Space Station
starship.context: The sixth Starship flight test photographed from the International Space Station in 2024. It is not a photograph of the selected flight.
starship.summary: SpaceX's Starship system consists of a large Super Heavy booster and upper-stage spacecraft. The program is developing full vehicle reuse.

new-glenn.title: New Glenn
new-glenn.context: An independently cleared NASA-owned vehicle photograph is not yet in this catalog.
new-glenn.summary: Blue Origin's New Glenn is a large orbital rocket designed around a reusable first stage.

escapade.name: ESCAPADE
escapade.title: ESCAPADE spacecraft during prelaunch processing
escapade.context: NASA's ESCAPADE spacecraft photographed during processing in 2024, not a live launch image.
escapade.summary: Twin spacecraft designed to investigate how the solar wind interacts with Mars's magnetic environment.

imap.name: IMAP
imap.title: NASA IMAP spacecraft during assembly and processing
imap.context: NASA's IMAP spacecraft during ground processing in 2025; not a photo from a future launch.
imap.summary: NASA's Interstellar Mapping and Acceleration Probe investigates the particles and boundaries of the heliosphere.
